direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just ended a call. Kasun notices that her manner has changed, without knowing why.
direction.people: Kasun stands frame right in a faded blue short-sleeved shirt, facing Anudi off frame left. His hands are empty below frame. He is concerned but gives her space. Anudi holds her phone off frame.

flow.text: Kasun watches Anudi as his small smile settles and his brow gathers slightly.
His eyes dip briefly, then return to her. He presses his lips together lightly and releases them.
His brow eases as he keeps his gaze on her, lips closed.

direction.camera: A steady frame on a tripod holds a 100mm shallow-focus close-up of Kasun from a roadside oblique angle, with him frame right looking into the left negative space.
direction.sound: Light rain on the roadside and the food three-wheeler; no music or speech.
